fields.body: A modern, premium fuel station built around your time, your vehicle and your peace of mind.

fields.title: A family business built on trust.
fields.subtitle: About Us

ourStory.title: Three decades. One promise.
ourStory.body: Founded in 1994 as a single-pump roadside station, we grew by stubbornly insisting on two things — pure fuel and warm service. Today we run one of the most-recognised premium forecourts in the region, serving thousands of vehicles every week.
ourStory.mission: Make every refuel feel premium, fast and worry-free.
ourStory.vision: Set the new global standard for the modern fuel station.
ourStory.services: Petrol, Diesel, Premium fuels, EV charging, Air & lounge.

people.name: Mr. Anil Verma
people.quote: We're not just selling fuel — we're selling time, trust and the confidence that your vehicle is in safe hands.

people.name: Ms. Priya Sharma
people.quote: Growth means nothing without integrity. We build every partnership and every litre of fuel on that foundation.

people.name: Mr. Rohit Khan
people.quote: My job is to make every shift seamless — safe pumps, clean forecourt, and a team that greets every customer like family.

fields.title: Moments from our station & community.
fields.subtitle: Events
fields.body: From grand openings to community drives — here's what's happening at Total Fuel Station.

fields.title: Everything your vehicle needs, under one canopy.
fields.subtitle: Services
fields.body: From premium fuels to EV charging, air, and convenience — see what is available at our station, with live stock and clear details.

fields.name: Rohit Sharma
fields.bio: Rohit leads day-to-day operations with a relentless focus on safety, cleanliness and customer experience. He has built our station into one of the highest-rated in the region.

fields.name: Priya Nair
fields.bio: Priya makes every guest feel at home. She runs our loyalty program and ensures every interaction reflects the premium standards of our brand.

fields.name: Arjun Mehta
fields.bio: Arjun keeps every pump, nozzle and tank in perfect health. His preventive maintenance program has kept our uptime above 99.9% for three years straight.

fields.name: Kabir Singh
fields.bio: Kabir is the smiling face you meet first. Fast, accurate and always courteous — he embodies the speed and warmth our customers love.

fields.title: Grand Opening of New Forecourt
fields.description: Unveiling our new ultra-modern forecourt with premium fuel dispensers and EV charging.
fields.long_description: We celebrated the launch of our newly upgraded forecourt featuring six new high-flow dispensers, two ultra-fast EV charging bays, and a redesigned customer lounge. Hundreds of customers joined us for live music, refreshments and exclusive fuel discounts.

fields.title: Diwali Night with our Community
fields.description: Lighting up the station with diyas, sweets and a warm thank you to our loyal customers.
fields.long_description: Our annual Diwali celebration brought together hundreds of families. We lit up the entire station with diyas, distributed sweets, and ran a special Diwali fuel cashback for every customer that evening.

fields.title: Green Drive — 500 Trees Planted
fields.description: A community-wide tree plantation drive to offset our annual carbon footprint.
fields.long_description: Our Green Drive initiative saw employees, customers and local NGOs come together to plant 500 native saplings around the station and along the highway. We commit to caring for every tree for the next 5 years.

fields.name: Aanya Kapoor
fields.text: Cleanest station I've ever visited. The staff is incredibly friendly and the fuel quality is top-notch.

fields.name: Vikram Bose
fields.text: Fast service, no queues even on weekends. Card payments and UPI work flawlessly. Highly recommended.

fields.name: Sneha Iyer
fields.text: Love the premium feel — feels like an Apple Store for fuel. Air checks and washroom are always spotless.

fields.name: Rahul Khanna
fields.text: Trusted this station for 6 years. Mileage of my car genuinely improved after switching here.

fields.title: Premium Petrol
fields.description: High-octane petrol for smoother drives and cleaner engines.
fields.long_description: Our Premium Petrol is formulated for modern engines that demand higher octane. Every delivery is quality-checked on arrival so you get consistent performance, better mileage, and fewer deposits over time. Available 24/7 at dedicated high-flow pumps.
highlights: Higher octane for turbo & premium cars
Quality tested on every tanker delivery

fields.title: Diesel
fields.description: Reliable diesel for cars, SUVs, and commercial fleets.
fields.long_description: Clean, calibrated diesel for daily drivers and fleet operators. Our pumps are regularly audited so dispensed volume matches what you pay for — trusted by local taxis, logistics vans, and highway traffic alike.
highlights: Suitable for cars, SUVs & light commercial

fields.title: EV Fast Charging
fields.description: Ultra-fast DC charging bays while you grab a coffee.
fields.long_description: Two dedicated EV charging bays with CCS connectors. Ideal for highway top-ups or a quick charge while you visit the lounge. Bay status is monitored by staff so you are never left waiting without help.
highlights: Pay via UPI / card at bay

fields.title: Air & Tyre Care
fields.description: Free air check and pressure top-up for every visitor.
fields.long_description: Maintain correct tyre pressure for safety and mileage. Our digital air points are free for customers — attendants can help set the PSI for your vehicle type.
